why: The answer gives the right fix from the book (end main with System.exit(0)) but never explains why the terminal hangs, so it is a bare correct rule with no justification.

concepts.quote: You need System.exit(0) at the end of main.
concepts.why: It repeats the book's rule for StdAudio programs but does not say why the program keeps running after the sound ends.
The answer says nothing about standard input or end-of-file; the hang is not caused by waiting for input.
